name: propfuel-os
description: Connects Claude Code to the PropFuel Marketing OS (propfuel-marketing-os.vercel.app). Claude gets a briefing before PropFuel work and logs progress, initiative updates and knowledge back to the OS, credited to you. Includes 12 team marketing skills (campaigns, SEO, social, articles, brand voice, research, competitive analysis, lead lists, slides). Plus 11 LinkedIn skills (posts, comments, replies, DMs, carousels, weekly plan, profile score, audits, humanizer) that load the OS LinkedIn brain and never post for you. Plus 8 more ECC skills (email drafting, growth log, product lens, brand discovery, click-path audit, browser QA, dashboards, research ops) and 2 agents (marketing-agent, seo-specialist). Plus 13 Instagram skills (reels, captions, carousels, stories, comments, replies, DMs, weekly plan, profile score, repurposing, audits, niche research, humanizer) that load the OS Instagram brain and never post for you. Plus apple-design (Emil Kowalski, MIT): Apple's interface and fluid-motion principles for the web, for any PropFuel UI. Plus winback-walkthrough: the prospect-branded 3-page win-back walkthrough (and its cover, bump and lateral emails) for a demo that didn't happen, from the Salesforce opp, published as a per-prospect web page (propfuel-winback). Plus propfuel-interactive-demo: interactive labs prospects play with (sliders, a PropFuel switch, a plain-language side panel), math only from published proof, shipped as a noindex preview then a GitHub-built propfuel.com page. Plus propfuel-motion-ad: video ads drawn entirely in code with HyperFrames (no AI footage, people or stock): XML brief + storyboard first, a 1-second test of the hardest beat, a timestamped keyframe sheet reviewed before the render, 9:16/4:5/1:1/16:9 and a 6s bumper, safe zones, burned-in captions, H.264 export and frame-QA contact sheets; product-UI beats and an effects library (Matter.js falling word cards, Rough.js hand-drawn marks, p5.brush textured swipe, PixiJS glow/glitch, thinking-orbs AI orb, optional Anime.js), all vendored and deterministic; never uploads.
